title: Exclusion denylist
description: Institutions the pipeline must never classify, propose, or write. An exclusion is a recusal, not an assessment. Merged at load time with an optional untracked local/excluded.json of the same shape, so an exclusion whose reason would disclose a private affiliation can be enforced without publishing the reason.

aliases.description: Every spelling the denylist must catch. Matched exactly, case-insensitively, against any institution string entering the pipeline.
